declaration.package_zh: 万感京张 三区片区策略 —— 街块诊断、界面规则、强度包络与走廊接驳判据
declaration.package_en: Every-Sense Jingzhang district strategy -- block diagnosis, frontage rules, intensity envelope and corridor/interchange criteria
statement_zh: 本文件只登记关系与判据，不登记任何法定控制值。容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度、绿地率与退线在本文件中一律不出现数值建议，理由与前提登记于 A-CONTROLS-001 与 A-12。
本文件出现的一切数值分两类：一类是 OpenStreetMap 快照的派生量算读数（街块面积、周长、距离、占比），标注为快照口径；一类是由前一类推得的参考标尺（如街块中位规模的等效方形边长），标注为参考值。参考值不是法定值，不得被援引为控制依据。
街块开放化候选只是设计回应的排序建议，不是可开放性判断。任一候选的可否开放取决于产权、内部通道现状、消防与安全条件，全部待核实。
本文件不承诺排期、不作投资测算、不标注任何保护范围。
statement_en: This file registers relations and criteria only, and no statutory control value. Floor-area ratio, building height, density, green-space ratio and setbacks carry no numeric recommendation anywhere in it; the reason and the preconditions are registered in A-CONTROLS-001 and A-12.

Every number here belongs to one of two classes: readings derived by measurement from the OpenStreetMap snapshot (block area, perimeter, distance, share), marked as snapshot-caliber; and reference scales derived from those readings (such as the equivalent square side of the median block size), marked as reference values. A reference value is not a statutory value and must not be cited as a control basis.

The block-opening candidates are a ranking of design responses, not a judgement that any block can be opened. Whether a candidate can be opened depends on tenure, the actual internal passages, and fire and safety conditions, all pending verification.
This file promises no schedule, performs no investment estimate, and marks no heritage protection extent.

license.notice_zh: 全部街块与轨道要素读数由 OpenStreetMap 数据派生，须按 ODbL 1.0 署名并以相同条件开放衍生数据库。
license.notice_en: All block and rail readings are derived from OpenStreetMap data and must be attributed and shared alike under ODbL 1.0.

provenance.snapshot_reassembly_zh: 由包内 osm-fabric-snapshot-part1.json 与 part2.json 按 osm-fabric-readings.json 登记的办法拼接（part1.ways + part2.ways 顺序拼接，nodes 取 part2），json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')) 序列化后 sha256 与上方登记值逐字节一致，本次已实测通过。
provenance.snapshot_reassembly_en: Reassembled from the package's osm-fabric-snapshot-part1.json and part2.json by the procedure registered in osm-fabric-readings.json (part1.ways then part2.ways, nodes from part2); serialised with json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':')), its sha256 matches the value above byte-exactly, verified in this run.
provenance.method_zh: 复用 compute_fabric.py 的可步行网络口径（同一 highway 排除集）与同一构面办法：以 OpenStreetMap 共享顶点建平面图、不做几何 noding、polygonize 取最小闭合环、代表点落入场地边界者为街块。本文件在该街块集合之上新增一步分组：按三处重点区临时多边形对街块代表点做点在面内判断，逐块登记面积、周长、质心、围合 way 与到提交中心线及十节点的最短距离。全程 EPSG:4548，无随机数。
provenance.method_en: Reuses compute_fabric.py's walkable-network definition (same highway exclusion set) and the same face construction: a planar graph on OpenStreetMap shared vertices, no geometric noding, polygonize to minimal closed rings, rings whose representative point falls inside the site boundary taken as blocks. This file adds one step on top of that set: a point-in-polygon grouping of block representative points by the three key-area provisional polygons, then a per-block register of area, perimeter, centroid, enclosing ways, and shortest distances to the submitted centrelines and the ten nodes. All in EPSG:4548, with no randomness.
provenance.verification_zh: 分组前先整体复现母读数：街块总数 1288、中位 1387.366 平方米、超大块 51 个、超大占比 52.324%，与 osm-fabric-readings.json 的 FAB-03 / FAB-04 逐位一致，证明本文件与母读数同源同口径。
provenance.verification_en: Before grouping, the parent readings were reproduced in full: 1288 blocks, median 1387.366 square metres, 51 oversized blocks, 52.324 per cent oversized share, digit-for-digit identical to FAB-03 and FAB-04 in osm-fabric-readings.json, evidencing that this file shares the parent's source and definitions.
known_limitations_zh: 封闭大院与园区内部道路若未被 OpenStreetMap 测绘，其外围会闭合成一个大面：本文件的超大街块候选因此系统性偏向「测绘稀疏处」，某个候选面很可能在现实中已经有内部通道。这一偏差不可由本文件消除，只能由现场调查消除，故每个候选都以内部通道现场核查为前提条件。
查询范围仅在场地 bbox 外扩 300 米，跨越查询边界的街块无法闭合，不进入本文件；场地南北两端的大尺度街坊因此存在漏计。
三处重点区多边形为临时粗略范围，分组结果随官方边界公开须整体重算。
known_limitations_en: Where roads inside gated compounds and campuses are unmapped in OpenStreetMap, their perimeter closes as one large face. The oversized-block candidates here are therefore systematically biased toward sparsely mapped places, and any given candidate may already have internal passages on the ground. This bias cannot be removed by this file, only by field survey, which is why every candidate carries internal-passage field verification as a precondition.

The query extent reaches only 300 metres beyond the site bbox, so blocks straddling the query edge cannot close and are absent here; the large-grain blocks at the north and south ends of the site are under-counted.
The three key-area polygons are provisional rough extents; the grouping must be recomputed in full once official boundaries are published.

site_reference.threshold_note_zh: 40000 平方米阈值沿用 FAB-04，属本包方法选择，不是规范强制值。
site_reference.threshold_note_en: The 40000 square metre threshold is carried over from FAB-04; it is this package's method choice, not a mandatory standard value.

frontage_rules.name_zh: 界面规则：把服务桌的四个位序放大到地块界面
frontage_rules.name_en: Frontage rules: the service desk's four positions scaled up to the parcel edge
frontage_rules.derivation_zh: 万感服务桌的四个位序（人工窗口、多通道信息位、AI 开关、退出回执位，顺序不可调换）与「不消费也能停留」两条既有承诺，本身只作用于一张桌子。界面规则是同一条逻辑在地块尺度的延伸：一段界面属于哪一类，取决于站在人行道上的人能否不经消费、不经账户、不经手机进入或停留，以及 AI 关闭后这段界面是否仍然给出同一件事的做法。
frontage_rules.derivation_en: The service desk's four fixed positions (human counter, multichannel information, AI switch, exit receipt, order non-negotiable) and the standing promise that staying requires no purchase apply to a single desk. These frontage rules extend the same logic to the parcel edge: which class a stretch of frontage belongs to is decided by whether a person on the footway can enter or stay without purchase, without an account and without a phone, and by whether that stretch still affords the same act once the AI layer is switched off.
frontage_rules.reference_scale_zh: 入口间距的参考标尺不是外部规范值，而是本场地自身的现状粒度：快照口径下街块中位规模 1387.366 平方米，等效方形边长约 37.2 米；逐区分别为众智园约 50.5 米、原点社区约 41.0 米、大钟寺约 31.1 米。三个数字构成「本区细粒街块的一条边」这一参考量级，作为活性界面入口间距的上限参考，取现状粒度而非外部经验值，是为了让判据在本场地可当场复核。参考值非法定值。口径成分与弃用理由：该中位数按全部街块计数取中，分母含 411 个小于 500 平方米的路幅面与人行道面，读数因此偏向小面一侧；另有面积 ≥1000 平方米子集的中位数 3922.71 平方米（等效方形边长约 62.6 米）同在读数文件内登记，本判据不采用。理由有二：1000 平方米下限本身属方法选择，且该子集把真正细粒的小街块排除在参考量级之外；取全部街块中位得到的是更小的上限值，对入口间距而言落在更严的一侧。两个口径并列登记，不得互相换算；成分与子集读数见 visual/assets/osm-fabric/osm-fabric-readings.json 的 FAB-03。
frontage_rules.reference_scale_en: The reference scale for entrance spacing is not an external standard value but this site's own existing grain: at snapshot caliber the median block size is 1387.366 square metres, an equivalent square side of about 37.2 metres, and per area about 50.5 metres in Zhongzhiyuan, 41.0 metres in the Origin Community and 31.1 metres in Dazhongsi. These three figures give the order of magnitude of one edge of a fine-grain block in each area and serve as the upper reference for active-frontage entrance spacing. Taking the existing grain rather than an external rule of thumb keeps the criterion checkable on site. A reference value is not a statutory value.Composition of the caliber and why the alternative was not used: this median is taken by count over all blocks, and its denominator holds 411 carriageway and sidewalk faces below 500 square metres, so the reading leans to the small-face side. The median of the subset at or above 1000 square metres, 3922.71 square metres or an equivalent square side of about 62.6 metres, is registered in the same readings file and is not used here for two reasons: the 1000 square metre floor is itself a method choice, and that subset excludes precisely the fine-grain blocks this reference is about. The all-block median yields the smaller upper bound, which for entrance spacing is the stricter side. The two calibers are registered side by side and may not be converted into one another.

classes.applies_zh: 主脊与三处横向接口沿线，凡开放化候选采用「边界渗透」或「角部开放」的边段。
classes.applies_en: Along the spine and the three lateral interfaces, on every edge where the opening candidate uses edge permeation or corner opening.
criteria_zh: 人工可及入口间距不大于本区街块中位规模的等效方形边长（众智园约 50.5 米、原点社区约 41.0 米、大钟寺约 31.1 米，参考区间取该值的 0.8—1.0 倍），任何两个休息点之间至少存在一个人工可及入口。
首层功能须至少包含一类可无账户、无手机完成的事项（问询、如厕、饮水、充电、等候、现金支付其一）。
AI 关闭态下该段界面的上述事项全部仍然成立，且成立方式不依赖临时人力加派。
criteria_en: Human-reachable entrances spaced no further apart than the equivalent square side of the area's median block size (about 50.5 metres in Zhongzhiyuan, 41.0 in the Origin Community, 31.1 in Dazhongsi; the reference band is 0.8 to 1.0 of that value), with at least one human-reachable entrance between any two rest points.
The ground floor must include at least one act completable without an account and without a phone: enquiry, toilet, drinking water, charging, waiting or cash payment.
With the AI layer off, every one of those acts still holds on that stretch, and holds without ad hoc extra staffing.
classes.check_zh: 现场核查项：入口间距实测、无账户事项清单核对、AI 关闭态成对复走。三项均落在零授权现场验证计划的可测范围内。
classes.check_en: Field checks: measured entrance spacing, checklist of account-free acts, and a paired re-walk with the AI layer off. All three sit inside the measurable range of the zero-authorisation field verification plan.

classes.applies_zh: 众智园受控测试庭、各类实验与测试用房沿公共空间的边段：可看见、可理解，但不可自由进入。
classes.applies_en: Edges of Zhongzhiyuan's controlled test court and of test and laboratory rooms facing public space: visible and intelligible, but not freely enterable.
criteria_zh: 凡不可自由进入的边段，必须在同一视线范围内挂靠一处活性界面点位，使「看得见但进不去」不会成为「看得见也问不到人」。
边段必须显示当前状态（测试中／开放／停机）与人工接管点方位，状态显示同时具备非视觉等价形式。
展示内容不得以人脸、持续定位或单一账户作为观看条件。
criteria_en: Every non-enterable edge must have an active-frontage point within the same line of sight, so that 'visible but not enterable' never becomes 'visible and nobody to ask'.
The edge must display current state (under test / open / stopped) and the bearing of the human handover point, with a non-visual equivalent of that state display.
Viewing must never be conditioned on face recognition, continuous location or a single account.
classes.check_zh: 现场核查项：视线内活性点位存在性、状态显示的非视觉等价、观看是否被账户拦截。
classes.check_en: Field checks: presence of an active point within sight, non-visual equivalent of the state display, and whether viewing is gated by an account.

classes.applies_zh: 低刺激安静替代路线沿线的边段，以及各区被指认为感官负荷退出方向的边段。
classes.applies_en: Edges along the low-stimulus alternative route and edges identified as the sensory-load exit direction in each area.
criteria_zh: 不设动态发光、不设主动声音输出、不设需要即时反应的交互构件；导视为铸刻或固定牌面。
静界面不等于封闭界面：每段静界面仍须有人工可及入口，只是入口不以声光招徕。
静界面段的夜间照度与声环境须与主脊段分别登记，不合并读数。
criteria_en: No dynamic illumination, no active sound output, no interaction element demanding an immediate response; wayfinding is engraved or fixed-panel.
Quiet frontage is not blank frontage: every stretch still carries human-reachable entrances, they simply do not solicit with light or sound.
Night illuminance and acoustics on quiet-frontage stretches are registered separately from the spine, never merged into one reading.
classes.check_zh: 现场核查项：夜间断点与导视可读性两项读数在静界面段单独取样，不与主脊样本合并。
classes.check_en: Field checks: the night-breaks and signage-legibility readings are sampled separately on quiet-frontage stretches and never pooled with spine samples.

frontage_rules.boundary_zh: 三类界面是设计判据，不是用地分类，也不是法定界面控制；本规则不规定建筑退线、贴线率、开窗率或立面材料。
frontage_rules.boundary_en: The three classes are design criteria, not a land-use classification and not a statutory frontage control; these rules prescribe no setback, no build-to ratio, no glazing ratio and no facade material.

intensity_envelope.name_zh: 强度包络：只给方向判据与不变量，不给数值
intensity_envelope.name_en: Intensity envelope: direction criteria and invariants only, no values
intensity_envelope.refusal_zh: 本节刻意不给出参考高度带、参考容积率区间或任何强度数值。理由不是资料不足，而是本包已在「控规官方参照台账」中明确承诺：在取得适用于自身范围的官方控制文件之前，不为任何地块提出容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度或绿地率的数值建议。以「参考区间」形式给出高度层数或强度倍数，会与该承诺直接冲突，并把一个无依据的数字放进评审可以援引的位置。因此本节把强度包络表达为方向判据与不变量：它们在没有控制值的情况下即可核对，在控制值到位后仍然成立，且不预占控制值。
intensity_envelope.refusal_en: This section deliberately gives no reference height band, no reference plot-ratio range and no intensity value. The reason is not thin evidence: this package has already committed, in its official regulatory-plan reference register, to recommending no plot ratio, building height, density or green-space ratio for any parcel until it holds official control documents applicable to its own extent. Presenting storeys or intensity multiples as a reference band would contradict that commitment directly and would place an unfounded number where a reviewer could cite it. The envelope is therefore expressed as direction criteria and invariants: checkable without control values, still valid once control values arrive, and pre-empting none of them.

gradient_direction.rule_zh: 街块内强度梯度的方向由该街块 AI 关闭态等价路径的承载位置决定：等价路径承载点所在的一侧为低强度侧，强度沿背离承载点的方向递增。判据是「关闭态服务不得被强度挤走」，不是「向主脊递增」或「向主脊递减」这类几何惯例。
gradient_direction.rule_en: The direction of the intensity gradient inside a block is set by where that block carries its AI-off equivalent route: the side bearing the equivalent route is the low-intensity side, and intensity rises away from it. The criterion is that AI-off service must not be displaced by intensity, not a geometric convention such as rising or falling toward the spine.
gradient_direction.why_zh: 把梯度锚在关闭态承载点上，是因为强度提升在实务中最先挤掉的正是低收益的人工窗口、等候位与现金替代位；若梯度方向由几何惯例决定，这些位置的存亡就取决于它们碰巧落在哪一侧。
gradient_direction.why_en: Anchoring the gradient to the AI-off carrier is a response to what intensity actually displaces first in practice: the low-yield human counter, the waiting position and the cash alternative. If the gradient followed a geometric convention, the survival of those positions would depend on which side they happened to fall.
gradient_direction.checkable_without_values_zh: 该判据不需要任何强度数值即可核对：只需回答「本街块的关闭态等价路径承载在哪一侧」与「拟提升的强度是否落在该侧」两问。
gradient_direction.checkable_without_values_en: The criterion needs no intensity value to check: it asks only which side of the block carries the AI-off equivalent route, and whether the proposed intensity increase falls on that side.

invariants.zh: 强度与界面解耦：任何强度增量不得以减少活性界面长度、减少人工可及入口数量或取消无账户事项为代价换取。二者若被打包为一次交易，该交易本身即为停止条件。
invariants.en: Intensity is decoupled from frontage: no increase in intensity may be traded against a reduction in active-frontage length, in the number of human-reachable entrances, or against the removal of account-free acts. If the two are bundled into one trade, that trade is itself a stop condition.

invariants.zh: 静界面段的强度增量必须附带该段夜间断点与导视可读性两项读数的复测，复测在增量落地前后各一轮；未复测者，该段增量不进入 G3 复核议程。
invariants.en: Any intensity increase on a quiet-frontage stretch must be accompanied by a re-measurement of that stretch's night-breaks and signage-legibility readings, once before and once after; without both, the increase does not reach the G3 review agenda.

invariants.zh: 开放化候选与强度包络不可互换：开放化是通行拓扑动作，强度是控制值范畴。以「已做开放化」换取强度上浮，或以「强度不变」免除开放化，两者都不成立。
invariants.en: Opening candidates and the intensity envelope are not interchangeable: opening is an act on the walking topology, intensity belongs to control values. Neither trading an opening for an intensity uplift nor waiving an opening because intensity is unchanged is admissible.

calibration_trigger.trigger_zh: 取得适用的官方控制文件及其计算边界；以及沿线街区控规批复成果与法定图则公开。
calibration_trigger.trigger_en: Receipt of applicable official planning controls and their calculation boundary; and publication of the corridor regulatory plan's approved outcome and statutory plan sheets.
calibration_trigger.on_trigger_zh: 触发后按 A-12 的既定重算范围执行：全部图层、指标与图纸整体重算；本文件的方向判据与三条不变量按官方控制值逐条复核并保留或撤销，责任专业为控规实施专业。
calibration_trigger.on_trigger_en: On trigger, the recalculation scope already registered under A-12 applies: all layers, metrics and drawings are recomputed in full. The direction criterion and the three invariants in this file are then re-checked item by item against the official control values and either retained or withdrawn, the responsible discipline being regulatory-plan implementation.

corridor_and_interchange.statement_zh: 本块只给判据与关系，不画线位、不定断面、不提出任何道路红线或过街工程结论。「中心线表达关系，不是道路红线、坡度、过街工程或施工线位」这一既有口径在本块全程适用。
corridor_and_interchange.statement_en: This block gives criteria and relations only. It draws no alignment, fixes no cross-section, and reaches no conclusion on road boundaries or crossing works. The package's standing caliber applies throughout: a centreline expresses relation, not a road boundary, gradient, crossing work or construction alignment.

rail_access.method_zh: 从同一快照取出全部 railway=station 与 railway=platform 要素（3 条 station way、25 条 platform way），投影至 EPSG:4548，按 150 米单链聚类合并为接入点簇，得 11 处；逐簇量测到三处重点区临时多边形与五条提交中心线的最短距离。150 米聚类半径为方法选择。
rail_access.method_en: All railway=station and railway=platform features are taken from the same snapshot (3 station ways, 25 platform ways), projected to EPSG:4548 and merged by single-link clustering at 150 metres into 11 access clusters; each cluster's shortest distance to the three key-area provisional polygons and to the five submitted centrelines is measured. The 150 metre clustering radius is a method choice.
rail_access.naming_limit_zh: 11 处接入点簇中只有西直门一处在快照中带有名称标签，其余 10 处的 way 无 name 标签。因此本文件按坐标与距离登记接入点，不指认站名——指认站名会超出快照能够支持的范围。
rail_access.naming_limit_en: Of the 11 clusters only Xizhimen carries a name tag in the snapshot; the ways of the other ten carry none. This file therefore registers access points by coordinate and distance and does not assert station names, since doing so would exceed what the snapshot can support.
sequence_zh: 第一序：众智园两处接入点簇均落在重点区内（距离 0 米），且距主脊中心线 17.5 米与 44.3 米。该区的接驳问题不是「到不到得了」，而是站与主脊之间那段最后两百米是否具备 AI 关闭态的等价路径——因此接驳深化的第一件事是这两处的关闭态成对复走，而不是新增接驳设施。
第二序：大钟寺最近接入点簇距重点区 101.6 米、距该区横向接口中心线 100.9 米，属贴邻但不在区内。接驳判据落在该 100 米区间内的过街与界面连续性上，与该区「零超大封闭街块、粒度已细」的诊断互为印证：问题在界面而不在街块。
第三序：原点社区最近接入点簇距重点区 685.2 米，落在 800 米内但不贴邻，且距主脊仅 30.5 米。该区的接驳依赖主脊本身承担步行接驳职责，因此主脊在该段的慢行连续性直接决定该区的轨道可达性。
第四序：西直门是唯一在快照中具名的接入点簇，距大钟寺重点区 2293.2 米，超出 800 米口径，但距主脊 211.6 米且位于场地内，是走廊南端的区域级换乘关系，按区域接驳登记而非按片区接驳登记。
sequence_en: First: both Zhongzhiyuan access clusters fall inside the key area (0 metres) and lie 17.5 and 44.3 metres from the spine centreline. Access here is not a question of reachability but of whether the last two hundred metres between platform and spine hold an AI-off equivalent route. The first act of interchange design is therefore a paired AI-off re-walk at these two points, not new interchange infrastructure.

Second: Dazhongsi's nearest cluster lies 101.6 metres from the key area and 100.9 metres from that area's lateral interface centreline: adjacent but outside. The criteria fall on crossing and frontage continuity within that 100 metre interval, which corroborates the area's diagnosis of zero oversized enclosed blocks and an already fine grain: the problem is frontage, not block size.

Third: the Origin Community's nearest cluster lies 685.2 metres away, inside the 800 metre caliber but not adjacent, and only 30.5 metres from the spine. Access here depends on the spine itself carrying the walking leg, so the spine's slow-mobility continuity on that stretch directly determines the area's rail accessibility.

Fourth: Xizhimen is the only cluster named in the snapshot, 2293.2 metres from the Dazhongsi key area and therefore outside the 800 metre caliber, but 211.6 metres from the spine and inside the site. It is a regional interchange relation at the corridor's southern end and is registered as regional access, not district access.

segmentation.method_zh: 沿五条提交中心线每 50 米取一个采样点，逐点在 EPSG:4548 下量测到最近城市干道要素（motorway/trunk/primary/secondary 及其 link）与最近步行专用要素（footway/path/steps/pedestrian/cycleway）的距离，按三条判据归类：A 公交优先候选段 = 60 米内存在干道要素；B 慢行专用候选段 = 30 米内存在步行专用要素且 120 米内无干道要素；C 共存段 = 其余。三个阈值均为本文件的方法选择，不是规范值；改变阈值将改变全部占比。判据只给出「该段应按哪种优先关系深化」，不给出车道数、断面、路权划分或线位。
segmentation.method_en: One sample every 50 metres along each of the five submitted centrelines; at each sample, distances in EPSG:4548 to the nearest urban arterial feature (motorway/trunk/primary/secondary and their links) and to the nearest pedestrian-dedicated feature (footway/path/steps/pedestrian/cycleway) are measured and classified by three criteria: A, transit-priority candidate, an arterial within 60 metres; B, slow-mobility-exclusive candidate, a pedestrian-dedicated feature within 30 metres and no arterial within 120 metres; C, shared segment, all others. All three thresholds are this file's method choices, not standard values; changing them changes every share. The criteria say only which priority relation a stretch should be developed under, and say nothing about lane counts, cross-sections, right-of-way allocation or alignment.

lines.reading_zh: 主脊 84% 的采样点在 60 米内存在城市干道要素，且无一处满足慢行专用判据。这条读数直接修正一个容易发生的误读：主脊不是一条独立于城市干道的公园步道，它在绝大部分长度上与城市干道贴线并行，因此深化时的主要问题是与干道的路权关系与过街，而不是园路铺装。仅有的连续共存段出现在自南端起 150—1700 米区间（南端为链距起点，西直门方向），是全线唯一可以按慢行主导深化的连续段落。
lines.reading_en: On 84 per cent of the spine's samples an urban arterial lies within 60 metres, and not one sample meets the slow-mobility-exclusive criterion. This reading corrects a ready misreading: the spine is not a park path independent of the city's arterials but runs alongside them over most of its length, so the governing questions in further design are right-of-way relation and crossing, not path paving. Its only continuous shared stretch runs from 150 to 1700 metres from the southern end (chainage zero, the Xizhimen end) and is the sole continuous stretch that can be developed under slow-mobility priority.

lines.reading_zh: 安静替代线的干道贴线率为 50%，比主脊低 34 个百分点，并有 13% 的采样点满足慢行专用判据（主脊为 0%）。据此可读出的结论是干道暴露显著更低（贴线率 50% 对主脊 84%），不是声学结论：贴线率是干道暴露的代理指标，不等于实测声环境。声学效果属待实测项，噪声读数在零授权现场验证计划的测量范围内，由夜间断点与照度读数在现场产出。此前本条曾据此读数写作「替代线确实更安静」，属以代理指标下声学结论的推理错误，v8.6 降格改正。
lines.reading_en: The quiet alternative runs adjacent to arterials on 50 per cent of samples, 34 percentage points below the spine, and 13 per cent of its samples meet the slow-mobility-exclusive criterion against the spine's zero. What follows from that is markedly lower arterial exposure — 50 per cent against the spine's 84 — and not an acoustic conclusion: arterial adjacency is a proxy for exposure, not measured acoustics. The acoustic effect awaits measurement; noise readings sit within the scope of the zero-authorisation field verification plan and are produced in the field by the night-breaks and illuminance rounds. This entry previously read the same figures as evidence that the alternative really is quieter, an inference from a proxy to an acoustic conclusion, corrected and downgraded in v8.6.

lines.reading_zh: 众智园横向接口 59% 贴线干道、无慢行专用段，接口深化以过街与路权协商为主。
lines.reading_en: Zhongzhiyuan's lateral interface is arterial-adjacent on 59 per cent of samples with no slow-mobility-exclusive stretch, so its development turns mainly on crossings and right-of-way negotiation.

lines.name_zh: 原点社区共同设计横向接口
lines.reading_zh: 原点社区横向接口是五条线中干道贴线率最低者（22%），慢行专用采样占比同为 22%，与正文既有读数「该接口走向 150 米内快照未记录任何屏障要素」一致：此处不是缝合难题，而是最有条件率先按慢行主导深化的一段。
lines.reading_en: The Origin Community's lateral interface has the lowest arterial adjacency of the five lines at 22 per cent, with an equal 22 per cent of samples slow-mobility-exclusive, consistent with the reading already in the text that no barrier feature is recorded within 150 metres of its alignment. This is not a stitching problem but the stretch best placed to be developed under slow-mobility priority first.

lines.name_zh: 大钟寺四象限包容采用接口
lines.reading_zh: 大钟寺横向接口三类判据分布最均衡（43/17/40），与该区「粒度已细、问题在界面」的街块诊断一致：分段深化的重点是三类段落之间的转换处，而不是任一段落内部。
lines.reading_en: Dazhongsi's lateral interface has the most even distribution of the three classes at 43/17/40, consistent with its block diagnosis of an already fine grain where the problem is frontage: the focus of segmented development is the transitions between the three classes rather than the interior of any one of them.

freight_and_support.name_zh: 货运、补给与保障车：时段分离与路径判据
freight_and_support.name_en: Freight, resupply and support vehicles: time separation and route criteria
freight_and_support.principle_zh: 货运与保障车不设专用路权，改设时段分离：同一段界面在不同时段承担不同职责，而不是在同一时段用不同空间承担不同职责。判据是「保障车的存在不得改变行人在该时段的既有做法」——若某时段的补给使人行连续净宽、触觉带或休息位失效，该时段即不成立，须改时段而不是改行人路径。
freight_and_support.principle_en: Freight and support vehicles receive no dedicated right of way; they receive time separation instead. The same stretch of frontage carries different duties at different times, rather than different duties in different spaces at the same time. The criterion is that a support vehicle's presence must not change what a pedestrian can already do at that hour: if a resupply window disables continuous clear width, the tactile band or a rest position, that window fails and the hour changes, never the pedestrian route.
route_criteria_zh: 补给路径优先取共存段（C 类）：C 类段既非干道贴线也非慢行专用，是时段分离代价最低的段落。
慢行专用候选段（B 类）不承担常规补给；该类段落的补给改由相邻 C 类段落的边界渗透口进入。
静界面段的补给时段不得落在夜间断点读数的取样时段内，避免补给活动污染该段的夜间读数。
route_criteria_en: Resupply routes take shared segments (class C) first: class C is neither arterial-adjacent nor slow-mobility-exclusive and carries the lowest cost of time separation.
Slow-mobility-exclusive candidates (class B) carry no routine resupply; supplies for those stretches enter through the edge-permeation openings of an adjacent class C stretch.
Resupply windows on quiet-frontage stretches must not fall inside the sampling window of the night-breaks reading, so that resupply activity does not contaminate that stretch's night readings.
freight_and_support.sla_linkage_zh: 保障车的响应关系不新设时限，直接挂既有维护 SLA 四级阶梯：一级现场人工与二级值守协调的建议时限决定保障车须能在何种时间尺度上到达任一点位，三级停止条件触发时保障车让位于停止执行而不是抢修，四级进入 G3 复核。本文件不提出任何新的响应时限数值。
freight_and_support.sla_linkage_en: Support-vehicle response introduces no new time limits and hangs directly on the existing four-level maintenance SLA: the suggested limits at level one, on-site human response, and level two, steward coordination, determine the time scale on which a support vehicle must be able to reach any point; when a level-three stop condition fires the support vehicle yields to executing the stop rather than to repair; level four enters G3 review. This file proposes no new response-time value.
freight_and_support.boundary_zh: 本段不提出货运车型、载重、停靠位尺寸、装卸时长或路权划分结论，全部待交通与运营专业在官方断面与真实班次条件下核定。
freight_and_support.boundary_en: This block proposes no vehicle type, payload, loading-bay dimension, dwell time or right-of-way conclusion; all await transport and operations professionals working from official cross-sections and real shift conditions.
